title: Stacked xswap chain: batch swap-in, mTHP reassembly and radix hole reclaim
subtitle: agy (gemini4argon) · line: xswap-superset-chain · base 5e84ca92 · 3 candidates · 209 guests / 3 builds

verdict.headline: Rejected chain: three stacked xswap commits never beat calibrated noise. M2 failed disk swap-in guards; probe metadata stayed at 0.111 bytes per slot. Every value review rejected; nothing to promote.

sections.title: Why this experiment
sections.lead: Upstream xswap swaps in one page per fault and only shrinks metadata from the tail. Three stacked commits tested batching, mTHP reassembly and interior hole reclaim.

blocks.takeaway: Each stage is a child commit of the previous stage

blocks.text: Git ancestry confirms the chain. Candidate records were relabelled generations 1 to 3 to match it; measurements and reviews are unchanged.

sections.title: Where the cost appears
sections.lead: Each stage targeted a hypothesised cost: per-fault swap-in work, mTHP folios split on zswap swap-in, and interior metadata pages pinned by one live high slot.

blocks.takeaway: Three hypothesised costs along the swap lifetime

blocks.text: These are the stated hypotheses, not measured findings.

sections.title: The affected path
sections.lead: M1 and M2 change the fault and readahead path; M3 changes how swapfile.c stores and frees cluster metadata.

blocks.takeaway: Where each stage sits in the swap path

blocks.text: The probe and fast tiers measure swap-in latency and metadata bytes per slot.

sections.title: What actually changed
sections.lead: M1 gates readahead on contiguous hits and enters synchronous swap-in allocator-first. M2 checks zswap residency for order-2 and order-4 folios. M3 stores clusters in 64-cluster chunks.

blocks.takeaway: M3 frees an empty interior chunk after an RCU grace period

blocks.text: The independent exact-tree review of M3 recorded no blockers.

blocks.x_label: Metadata bytes per 1,000 capacity slots (baseline only)
blocks.note: Valid calibration samples; candidate performance was not measured here.

sections.title: The next decision
sections.lead: Gains were M1 +3.5% (noise 9.0%), M2 +0.2% (noise 3.5%, guards failed) and M3 -0.05% (noise 4.2%). All value reviews rejected the chain.

blocks.takeaway: Keep the chain as negative knowledge; measure M3 on fragmented swap

blocks.text: Baseline and every stage measured 0.111 metadata bytes per slot. The probe likely created no interior holes, so M3's reclaim benefit is unmeasured (inference).

sections.title: Core kernel patches (M1 → M2 → M3)

blocks.takeaway: M1 5cde9eaa: allocator-first sync swap-in and streak-gated readahead (git diff 5e84ca92..5cde9eaa)
M2 53e02e86: zswap mTHP residency check and subpage zswap_load (git diff 5cde9eaa..53e02e86)
M3 2c1ddb53: two-level cluster_dir chunks and interior hole reclaim (git diff 53e02e86..2c1ddb53)

sections.lead: Verbatim largest hunks of each stage's incremental git diff; full cumulative patches are the pinned sources.
